title: syzygium subracemosum
intro: Syzygium subracemosum, commonly known as the 'Malabar Plum', is a species of flowering plant in the family Myrtaceae. The Malabar Plum is known for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to act as a diuretic, helping to reduce water retention and alleviate conditions such as bloating and swelling. The plant's therapeutic actions also include its antimicrobial properties, which aid in the treatment of wounds and infections. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its various medicinal properties.
